subject.title: feat(ui): group native session catalog rows by project in the sidebar

question: Should existing browser profiles with no catalog-grouping preference switch to grouped mode by default for both Codex and Claude catalogs?
rationale: This is a new user-visible persisted preference whose absent-value behavior changes the shipped sidebar layout on upgrade; tests can prove mechanics but cannot choose the product default.

options.title: Default grouped
options.body: Accept the new grouped layout for upgrades, retain the shared flatten toggle, and require live proof plus collision-safe labels before merge.

options.title: Default flat
options.body: Preserve the shipped flat layout when the key is absent and make project grouping an explicit opt-in.

recommendation.title: Default grouped
recommendation.body: Accept the new grouped layout for upgrades, retain the shared flatten toggle, and require live proof plus collision-safe labels before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available release and adjacent Control UI routing signal for confirming an upgrade-visible default.
